name: A4 塑性纸张 · 可揉皱纸团原型
description: 球形软压缩形成松散纸团，释放后保形；离散薄壳塑性 + IPC 连续碰撞检测；未接入手指
upstream_origin: FQ authored discrete shell and plastic hinge model; IPC Toolkit collision library
license_status: FQ implementation with IPC Toolkit dependency (MIT); previous kami solver remains MIT with attribution
viewer_status: 球形软压缩 → 释放 → 落桌后保持松散纸团
IPC 连续检测，保存并复核内部变形路径
参数未实测标定；无手指夹持、无纸层摩擦
limitations: Validated for the supplied loose-ball spherical soft-compression test only; tighter compression exceeds the 1% edge-strain acceptance threshold
FQ discrete edge-spring / dihedral plastic shell, uncalibrated material and rate-dependent plastic update
Frictionless self contact; no tearing, paper fiber anisotropy or moisture model
Soft spherical penalty fixture, not rigid enclosing hardware, human fingers or robot manipulation
CCD uses numerical tolerances and 0.1 mm minimum clearance; not an exact arithmetic proof
USD playback follows recorded CCD-checked internal solver paths; it is not native PhysX dynamics
MuJoCo preview is a visual snapshot with no native deformable physics or collision proxy

demonstration.title: A4 纸压成松散纸团并释放 · IPC 实验
demonstration.caption: 外部软球形压缩驱动；FQ 薄壳/塑性模型 + IPC，MuJoCo 渲染。无手指策略，参数未标定。
